description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for handling Microsoft Teams message data, including HTML decoding, quote extraction, ID normalization, and mention detection.

methods.name: decodeHtmlEntities
methods.description: Decodes common HTML entities to plain text.

methods.name: htmlToPlainText
methods.description: Strips HTML tags from a string, preserving text content.

methods.name: extractMSTeamsQuoteInfo
methods.description: Extracts quote information from MS Teams HTML reply attachments.

methods.name: normalizeMSTeamsConversationId
methods.description: Normalizes MS Teams conversation IDs by removing extra parameters.

methods.name: extractMSTeamsConversationMessageId
methods.description: Extracts message ID from raw MS Teams message identifiers.

methods.name: parseMSTeamsActivityTimestamp
methods.description: Parses various formats of activity timestamps into Date objects.

methods.name: stripMSTeamsMentionTags
methods.description: Removes <at> tags from MS Teams mention texts.

methods.name: translateMSTeamsDmConversationIdForGraph
methods.description: Converts MS Teams direct message conversation IDs to Graph API format.

methods.name: wasMSTeamsBotMentioned
methods.description: Checks if the bot was mentioned in a MS Teams activity.
